hints.title: Bicolored Path Exploration
hints.text: The shortest distance to any node depends on whether the arrival edge was red or blue.

hints.title: Augmented State Breadth Search
hints.text: Form a queue tracking (node, last_color) pairs. Alternating edges must switch colors on each traversal step.

hints.title: Queue State Blueprint
hints.text: Seed queue with (0, 0) for red and (0, 1) for blue with distance 0. Advance across opposing color edges, tracking visited state per color.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: E: total number of red and blue edges
complexity.notes: Each vertex is visited at most twice (once via red incoming edge, once via blue incoming edge).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tracking visited nodes without incoming edge color prevents revisiting a node with the alternate color necessary to proceed.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Doubling the state space to (node, color) guarantees acyclic progression without exponential path exploration.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Breadth-first search with composite state (node, last_color).
